==Active Ability: Ritual==
Upon being maxed {{PAGENAME}} will gain the ability to delete itself in return for summoning [[Divine General]].

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==
* {{PAGENAME}} is a '''meta support''' due to his ability to '''summon''' [[Divine General]] rather than his curse effect
* {{PAGENAME}} has a 100% chance to apply [[Effects|Curse]].
* Only one [https://animeadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Divine_General Divine General] can be summoned from each player, meaning that Ritual won't function if you try to use it if one has already been summoned.
* It is recommended to get unique on Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) as it allows you to place another down after you have summoned [https://animeadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Divine_General Divine General] on a fully maxed out Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual), also allowing them both to increase dps significantly.
